name: Cursor Cloud Agents
description: Expose Cursor Cloud Agents tools to the Mattermost Agents plugin via MCP.

settings_schema.header: The service account key below powers MCP tools for the Mattermost Agents plugin.

settings.help_text: Used for all MCP tool calls made through the Mattermost Agents plugin, so invoking users do not need their own Cursor access. Create a service account key from the Cursor Dashboard.
Override for testing. Leave empty to use https://api.cursor.com.

settings.display_name: Expose MCP tools through the public Mattermost MCP server
settings.help_text: When enabled, this plugin's MCP tools are exposed through the public Mattermost MCP server (served by the Mattermost Agents plugin). Stays off unless an admin turns it on.
